power_flow_intuitive_v7.html.description: v7 now aligned with v6_fixed patterns: includes large-scale system generators (generateIEEE30System, generateRandomPowerSystem), getDynamicProblem for unified problem handling, spy plot and network graph visualizations, and adaptive rendering for performance optimization

archive/README.md.description: Archive directory created for deprecated files. Contains old intuitive visualizer versions (original, v3, v4, v5, v6). README.md documents why files were deprecated and which current versions to use (v6_fixed, v7). Pattern: move deprecated files to archive/ with README explaining migration path.

index.html.description: Updated to link only to current versions with file organization section. Fixed broken .html links to .md files. Documents shared modules (ieee_cases.js, power_flow_engine.js, power_flow_utils.js), current versions (v6_fixed recommended, v7 for large-scale), and archive directory reference.

tests/verify_ieee14_algorithms.html.description: Browser-based IEEE 14-bus algorithm verification test suite. Tests Newton-Raphson, Gauss-Seidel, Fast Decoupled XB, and DC Power Flow methods. Compares results against MATPOWER reference values with 1.5% tolerance. Auto-runs on page load.

all pages.description: All main HTML pages verified for console error-free operation. DOM elements match getElementById calls, script dependencies exist, and console statements are intentional (informational/warnings only).
